mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_reminder_read (user_id,kind,source_id,glucose_value,recorded_at,replied_at,reply_hash) VALUES (#{userId},#{kind},#{row.sourceId},#{row.glucoseValue},#{row.recordedAt},#{row.repliedAt},#{replyHash}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE glucose_value = VALUES(glucose_value), recorded_at = VALUES(recorded_at), replied_at = VALUES(replied_at), reply_hash = VALUES(reply_hash), read_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
